text:
Elaine: Ran a sweep this morning comparing kernel picks on A100 vs H100 for long-seq workloads (seq_len 2048/4096). Seeing a ~7-9% p99 regression on H100 when KV-prefetch is enabled. Suspect register pressure from the prefetched KV + larger tile size.
Matt: ugh. do you have the perf samples? nsight or nvprof output?
Elaine: pasted the sampling output below from nsight (trimmed):
```
GPU: H100
kernel: attn_kv_prefetch_tiled
avg_regs_per_thread: 64
smem_dynamic: 12KB
warp_occupancy: 50%
stall_reason: reg_spill + mem_barrier
```
Also compared the fallback kernel (smaller tile) which keeps regs ~48 and occupancy ~75% and no p99 hit.
Jordan: sounds like the autotuner picked the prefetch/tile combo optimized for A100 but it's wrong on H100. A100 had better SMEM-to-reg tradeoffs.
Nina: did you repro with the smaller batch sizes? I remember small batches sometimes prefer the high-smem path because batching hides latency.
Elaine: yes, small batches (bs=1..4) didn't regress; the problem shows up at bs>=8 and seq_len>=2048. So it's sequence-length dependent plus batch-pressure.
Matt: potential fixes: 1) add arch-aware constraint to autotuner so H100 picks lower tile_size when KV-prefetch on, 2) add a lightweight reg-reduction compile path (split compute into two kernels), 3) reduce aggressive prefetch depth when seq_len>1024.
Jordan: I can add a quick patch to the tuner to tag kernel candidates with estimated reg usage and occupancy on each device family. Then we can prune candidates where occupancy < 60% for production SLOs.
Nina: Agree. We should also add a microbenchmark: toggle prefetch depth 0..4 and tile_size {64,96,128} across devices and capture p50/p95/p99 + inst_metrics. Put it in perf lab so CI can catch regressions.
perf-bot: Benchmark job #1953 finished: https://ci.example/reports/1953 — shows H100 attn_kv_prefetch_tiled p99 +8% (baseline: 1952).
Elaine: thanks. I'll upload the nsight traces to the perf drive and tag the autotune PR. For now I'll flip the default autotune policy to prefer the lower-smem kernel for h100 in canary.
Matt: small note — watch register allocation flags. On the last compile we enabled inline-fusing which bumped regs. Maybe disable fusion for the prefetch path.
Jordan: action items: 1) Jordan: implement arch-aware pruning in autotuner (WIP) 2) Nina: add microbenchmark matrix to perf lab (ticket #PL-482) 3) Elaine: canary config change + upload traces 4) Matt: test disable-fusion compile flag impact.
Nina: I'll file PL-482 and link perf-bot reports.
Elaine: adding a short checklist in the PR description so QA can repro. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Matt: nice triage. We'll monitor canary and revert if more regressions show up. :thinking:
